Composer Metadata
=================
Autoload metadata and helper classes generated by Composer for mPDF.

Contents
--------
- autoload_*.php, ClassLoader.php, platform_check.php – autoloader wiring and platform checks.
- installed.php / installed.json / InstalledVersions.php – package version metadata.
- LICENSE – Composer license.

Notes
-----
- Generated files; do not edit by hand. Regenerate via Composer when upgrading dependencies.
